_comment: Replacement for the node currently named 'scan crop image via ai'.
Renamed to 'ai validation ocr and omr'.
1. It now also reads the 20 bubble rows. It did not before -- the
responseSchema had only the six text fields -- so there was nothing to
reconcile Python's OMR against. maxOutputTokens went 200 -> 2048.
2. THE SCALE IS LETTERS, NOT NUMBERS. Verified two ways: against
omr_ground_truth_merged.json (24 labelled forms, 480 rows, whose only
answer values are O/VS/S/F/US/blank), and against the legend the app
itself prints in pdf_service.dart:426 --
O  Outstanding        4.21-5.00  -> 5
VS Very Satisfactory  3.41-4.20  -> 4
S  Satisfactory       2.61-3.40  -> 3
US Unsatisfactory     1.00-1.80  -> 1
Note F ranks ABOVE US. The schema constrains every row to an enum of
exactly those letters plus 'blank', so the model cannot invent a value.
The reconciler converts letters to numbers; Gemini is told not to.
3. Row order verified: management is ground-truth indices 0-9, performance
is 10-19, and every labelled form has exactly 20 rows.
4. No inline API key -- uses Predefined Credential Type ->
'Google Gemini(PaLM) Api', the credential the three LLM Chain nodes
already use. If it is missing from that dropdown, fall back to Generic
Credential Type -> Header Auth, header name 'x-goog-api-key'.
name: ai validation ocr and omr
